songs.name: I've Been All Around This World

ai_show_review.summary: Acoustic gold with Hard To Handle, Katie Mae and a memorable amp‑failure interlude
ai_show_review.blurb: The show pivots around an unexpected acoustic half that many call pure gold. Highlights include Hard To Handle, Katie Mae, Saw Mill and Long Black Limousine, while Phil’s busted amp sparks a quirky but inspired second set. Soundboard capture is crystal clear, making this a must‑listen early‑Dead performance.
ai_show_review.review: January 31, 1970 at The Warehouse in New Orleans captures the Grateful Dead at an oddly tender crossroads. A blown bass amp after the first electric set forced Phil Lesh and the band into an acoustic segment that turned into one of the night’s biggest strengths – blue‑grass numbers like Little Sadie, Been All Around This World and a heartfelt solo on Katie Mae showcase Jerry’s crisp lead work and Pigpen’s soulful organ and harmonica. The electric half still burns with Hard To Handle, Long Black Limousine and Saw Mill, while the third set rounds out the night with Black Peter and Cumberland Blues. Both soundboard recordings are praised for their clarity; the “fixed” Cotsman SBD is especially lauded for its clean mix and captured stage banter, making it the definitive listening source.

rating_calculation.sentiment_rationale: Both recordings are described with strong positive language – ‘excellent soundboard capture’, ‘quirky early‑Dead show’, ‘pure gold’ acoustic half, and multiple standout song mentions. No negative comments appear, indicating consistent high praise across sources.

best_recording.reason: Excellent soundboard with clear, crisp mix and no drop‑outs; captures the acoustic interlude and stage banter perfectly.

key_highlights: Unexpected acoustic half becomes a highlight after Phil’s amp failure
Hard To Handle delivered with intense Jerry guitar work
Pigpen shines on country/bluegrass numbers and solo acoustic moment on Katie Mae
Overall soundboard quality is excellent, preserving stage banter and nuance
song_highlights: I've Been All Around This World

band_performance.Jerry: Delivers strong lead work on bluegrass tunes and an intense, angry solo on Hard To Handle.
band_performance.Phil: Amp blows after the first set, yet his bass underpins the acoustic interlude and drives the second set’s inspired moments.
band_performance.Bob: Pigpen dominates the country/bluegrass selections – Big Boss Man, Hard To Handle, Long Black Limousine, Seasons Of My Heart and Saw Mill – and adds a rare solo acoustic guitar moment on Katie Mae.

must_listen_sequences: I've Been All Around This World
